title: Ellis Stratkos, trombonist turned Biloxi union secretary
summary: Kelly met Stratkos on a tour with Norman Brownlee's band in the Depression; he later ran a candy shop in Biloxi.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: So many musicians down there, but the impression of the trombone is especially interesting to me. I think of somebody like, I wonder what happened to Ellis Stratkos during that period. Where was he?
Well, after I met Ellis when he had just come in for a tour with Norman Brownlee's band. And I guess there wasn't much work around there because it was right in the middle of

And the next thing I heard of him, he was secretary of the union in Biloxi and running a candy shop. That's the last I've heard of Ellis, but I knew him real well. He was a gentleman and extremely nice man.
I guess Biloxi. Because that's where he went back to and I think probably his father had been in the candy business. And he took it over.
